newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot propane unchanged in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot propane unchanged in quiet trade.

text.p: U.S. spot propane prices held steady in quiet late trade on Friday following brisk activity this morning that perked up values, players said.
Traders said sellers held onto their numbers largely because of cold weather in the Midwest amid continuing crop drying demand and the approach of winter.
"A lot of it is emotional," said one Conway trader.
Propane had plunged on Thursday, tracking weak NYMEX crude oil futures.
In the Conway, Kansas, hub spot propane remained between 56.25 cents and 56.50 cents a gallon. Deals were done earlier as low as 54.00 cents and as high as 56.50 cents.
The U.S. Gulf Coast also stayed steady, at 53.50/54.00 cents.
Players said propane was the focus of the market, with activity in the other liquid gases very light.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
